articles.title: African quartet secure Women's World Cup places
articles.summary: Algeria, Morocco, Cameroon and Malawi all qualify for the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil by reaching the semi-finals of the Women's Africa Cup of Nations.

articles.title: Five-time Super League winner Makinson to retire at end of 2026 campaign
articles.summary: Tommy Makinson has announced he will retire from rugby league at the end of the current 2026 Super League campaign.
